# flutter_agent_harness

**Tag**: agent, llm, ai, streaming, flutter, mobile, state-management

## 简介

Cross-platform AI agent harness for Dart and Flutter: streaming provider adapters, agent loop with tools, session persistence, context compaction.

## 官网

- 主页: https://fa1.dev
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_agent_harness
